provenance.mammal_selection: 100 extant non-domestic species: 20 cold/montane candidates, 20 arid/semiarid candidates, 20 warm-region candidates, 20 generalist/temperate candidates, 20 additional taxonomically diverse species. Selection groups are editorial sampling strata, not verified adaptation labels or teacher answers; no response-based filtering.
provenance.bird_size_classes: Editorial bins of typical adult mass: tiny (<10 g), small (<200 g), medium (<2000 g), large (<10000 g), very_large (>=10000 g). Not an individual measured mass.
provenance.unknown_policy: Uncollected raw attributes are null or omitted. Feature judgments use 0/0.5/1, with 0.5 for ambiguous evidence. Intermediate states, source missingness, and induced ambiguity are recorded separately.
provenance.construction: 6 bird and 6 plant species with constructed states; 100 distinct mammal species; human and legal profiles are fictional.
provenance.source_scope: Curated supplementary sources. ConceptNet has not been collected for this implementation.
provenance.mammal_adaptation_reference: Feature thresholds separate morphological/physiological adaptations from survival in a specific test or avoidance alone. Example desert mechanisms: https://www.nationalzoo.si.edu/animals/news/how-does-fennec-fox-survive-desert-and-other-questions-answered
